system_thesis_interpretation: V7 is a terminal finite-symbolic conformance governance proposal and not an experiment on, implementation of, or evidence for the paper-level Dream-LoRA-Think thesis. Its only architectural purpose is to make the already-settled pure-CPU kernel comparison and post-freeze scope-audit protocols constructible and honestly typed while preserving the paper-first directive as inactive context. The exact cleanup is limited to three V6 consensus repairs: explicit comparator call/observation direction with stimulus/expectation separation, a standalone non-self-referential audit-request grammar with later receipt binding, and a narrow mechanical SK10 tier separated from fresh independent human semantic review and explicit human adjudication. LOCAL remains target-local calibration information rather than atoms, graph/RAG, or a fair baseline; MOTIF_SCHEMA is given the full persistent graph rather than learning schema induction; RANDOM_SOURCE is an exhaustive finite product measure rather than stochastic execution. V7 contains no renderer, random/rendered world, source life, target agent, model/provider/tokenizer, DREAM/SLEEP/reader/memory, retrieval, LoRA/weights, GPU/remote action, benchmark, promotion, or scientific claim. A future exact all-pass could support only the bounded non-headline conformance statement in C01 and would grant no security, learned-system, model, paper, benchmark, promotion, successor, or scientific authority.
graph_delta_interpretation: The sole canonical predecessor is the exact 132-byte compact lexicographically sorted base_state.json plus one LF at SHA-256 c5468731c271bf0bd39f97f672a36ad89305304ec3f6b282a31bffa96363d7d8. It has protocol FELTCRAFT_UNIMPLEMENTED_PROPOSAL_BASE_V1, the exact six-key object, and nodes, edges, loops, claims, and implemented_change_ids all empty. Every V7 graph entry is therefore an add and no V1-V6 runtime identifier or behavior is inherited. The complete final registry is exactly six nodes: SKN01 authority, SKN02 enumerator, container SKN03 with four isolated projections, SKN04 twin/cost/bridge/deletion checker, SKN06 comparator, and terminal SKN05 validator. Its thirteen directed edges are exact and endpoint-closed: SKE01-SKE04 carry only narrow authority/control or path-hash binding to enumerator, projections, checker, and validator; SKE05-SKE06 carry legal enumerator tuples to projections/checker; SKE07/SKE08 are distinct comparator-to-enumerator call and enumerator-to-comparator observation directions; SKE09/SKE10 similarly separate addressed projection call from return/exception observation; SKE11/SKE12 similarly separate checker call from observation; and SKE13 alone carries fixed aggregates plus ordered SK01-SK08 receipts from SKN06 to SKN05. No reverse, callback, forwarding, or bidirectionality is implicit. The governance oracle is partitioned into positive and negative call stimuli, corresponding expected results or exact expected error type/code/args, and fixed-twin stimuli/expectations. SKN06 binds those constants independently, sends exactly one addressed stimulus on one call edge, receives exactly its one immutable return or exception on the distinct reverse edge, and retains expectations and mismatch details locally. Candidates never receive expectations, another candidate's stimulus, prior observations, mismatch state, receipts, golden bytes, filesystem/environment/configuration/cache/RNG/dynamic-import access, audit material, or a successor endpoint. SKN05 receives no per-case stimulus, result, exception, expectation, mismatch, oracle byte, or SK09 result; it independently binds only the exact 2102-byte V7 golden at SHA-256 dce3fe74e5f4918f306dd365fad984bd3440c168348b92f7dbb5efa1652bccb4, derives SK09 from exact-byte and six-mutation checks, emits no successful report on upstream failure, and has no outgoing or scientific edge. SK10 and HUMAN_GOVERNANCE_REVIEW are external visibility stages, not runtime graph nodes.
loop_delta_interpretation: The final loop registry contains exactly two additions against the verified empty base. SKL01 is the only active loop before approval: schema-valid exact bound bytes may receive at least two fresh independent interpretations, cross-critique, concern-by-concern adjudicated consensus, and a separate human-authored ratification. The model deliberation runner always stops at human_required and cannot ratify or imply authority. The intake validator requires a technically releasable proceed_to_implementation consensus with no unresolved disposition, then validates the real transitive chain: ratification/change/intake/consensus identifiers agree; consensus binds SHA256(change); the paused state binds exact change and consensus bytes; ratification binds exact consensus and paused-state bytes; authorization evidence is a real UTF-8 path/hash/excerpt binding; ratification scopes exactly equal the sorted canonical scope proposal; and the sole approval transition binds the paused-state hash and exact ratification bytes. There is no ratification.change_sha256 shortcut, and rework/reject/defer cannot be human-smoothed into release. SKL02 remains dormant until that complete chain releases exactly the three requested atoms and preserves exactly the eight forbidden atoms. Only then may one addressed candidate stimulus at a time traverse SKE07, SKE09, or SKE11, with observations returning only on SKE08, SKE10, or SKE12; only aggregates/receipts may cross SKE13; only exact SK01-SK09 all-pass may write the canonical report; and only after freezing exactly five files may a separate request, mechanical SK10 checks, fresh independent semantic source review, explicit human governance adjudication, and a governance-only receipt be created. The loop terminates on failure/no report or exact terminal report plus human-adjudicated external audit and has no renderer, life, model, GPU, benchmark, promotion, paper, claim, or successor transition.
claim_delta_interpretation: The complete final claim registry is exactly six non-headline additions against the empty base. C01 permits only a future statement that one pure CPU implementation conforms to the bound finite invariants and golden bytes through the declared comparator path after exact ratification and evidence; it grants no security, benchmark, model, paper, promotion, or science authority. C02 states only the exact closed-domain information values LOCAL=RANDOM_SOURCE=1/4 and MOTIF_SCHEMA=ORACLE=1, with LOCAL explicitly target-local and MOTIF explicitly complete-graph-fed. C03 states only the declared involutive non-automorphic twin, preserved scalar costs, and namespace-tagged two-product deletion necessity, while denying substitution, shortest-path, learned-composition, and developmental inference. C04-C06 are active negative boundaries: V7 constructs no fair atoms/graph/RAG baseline, no rendered or learned system or paper result, and no golden vector, report, comparator output, audit check, manifest, receipt, independent-review attestation, human adjudication, or governance artifact is scientific evidence, a security proof, a promotion token, or successor input. The exact requested scope is the sorted list [pure_cpu_symbolic_alignment_enumerator, symbolic_golden_report_and_scope_audit, symbolic_kernel_unit_and_property_tests]. The exact forbidden scope is the sorted list [benchmark_or_scientific_claims, dream_sleep_reader_or_memory_implementation, gpu_or_remote_actions, lora_model_or_weight_operations, model_provider_or_tokenizer_calls, promotion_to_rendered_or_model_stage, random_or_rendered_world_generation, source_life_or_target_agent_execution]. visibility_matrix_interpretation: The visibility declaration has exactly 199 unique information items, eleven unique stages, and 2,189 unique cells, which is the complete 199 by 11 Cartesian product with no missing, duplicate, or extra pair. The eleven stages intentionally expand graph node SKN03 into four mutually isolated projection principals and add external SK10 plus human governance; stage and node cardinalities therefore differ without enlarging the runtime registry. All six independent oracle partitions are visible only to SKN06 and human governance and forbidden to authority, every candidate, SKN05, and SK10. A single-addressed stimulus is visible only to SKN06, the addressed candidate class, and human governance under the contract's per-invocation address semantics; each concrete projection input field is visible only to its named projection, SKN06, and human governance. Candidate observation families and mismatch details terminate at SKN06/human governance, while only aggregate domain/vector/negative/twin-cost-bridge-deletion counts and SK01-SK08 receipts also become visible to SKN05. Golden report bytes and report fields are terminal at SKN05/human governance; SK10 sees only the separately named public path/hash binding, never runtime report bytes or fields. The deterministic SK10 tier is limited to fixed-binding equality; recursive path, raw byte, size, hash, manifest, root digest, and Git diff path equality; request JCS/schema/path-hash/content equivalence; timestamp order; fixed Python-3.9 ast.parse success; and literal Import/ImportFrom inventory plus the exact local resolution and six-module allowlist. SK07 preserves exactly 36,864 typed bridge cases, 73,728 single-product deletions under the fewer-than-eight recreation predicate, zero failures, and [36864,73728,0], supporting only the declared deletion-necessity result. SK08 exhausts legal domains 12/96/27,648/192 with values 1/4,1,1/4,1; compares all 72 copied vectors; sends the exact ordered 25 negative stimuli once without their expected exceptions; requires exact DomainError type/code/args, precedence, timing, histogram, no side effect, and zero mismatches; and expects [12,96,27648,192,72,25,25,0]. SK10 validates a separate request against the exact request schema, later binds its exact bytes by fixed path/hash/copied-content equivalence, freezes and manifests exactly the five declared files against full diff base 742f8bfa4bf4e530fdf264150bff962506fe449f, performs only the thirteen declared mechanical booleans, and then requires fresh identity-distinct human review of all six semantic categories and all eight forbidden atoms with no finding or ambiguity plus explicit human governance adjudication. Its pass is terminal governance evidence only and asserts neither deterministic semantic completeness nor security/scientific proof. SK01-SK10 have not been executed, no implementation or evidence is claimed, and all runtime/audit work remains forbidden before a releasable consensus and separate exact human ratification.
